name: M3_CRS420MI_Delete
description: Delete a single application message identified by its unique mail id. The operation removes the message from the application message inbox in M3 so it is no longer available for display, listing, or further processing. It is intended for targeted removal of specific messages, in contrast to the separate operation that reorganizes and removes old messages in bulk based on removal date and status. No data is returned on success.

inputParameters.name: MLID
inputParameters.description: Unique mail ID of the application message to delete.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number for the application message to delete.
